page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Title lines at top, then a woodcut engraving in the middle, then the imprint and date below it. No margin text, running head or page number.

l.i: Scholasticis ex solertissimorum ac sagacissimorum seculi
nostri Interpretum Naturæ scriptis, methodicè[?], digestus

page.notes: The engraving between the title and the imprint is a decorative woodcut in an architectural frame: a stag-headed figure (Actaeon-like) stands in a landscape with a town, a scroll reading "POSTERITATI" lies below him, a cherub sits at the bottom centre, a female figure stands at the left and a helmeted armed figure at the right, with cherubs at the top and small roundels at the bottom left (a man with a staff) and bottom right (a ship). The date is printed as cIↄ. Iↄ. CV., which is MDCV. The word "methodicè" ends in a mark that is hard to read; it is taken as è with [?]. A handwritten "3." with a crossed-out mark stands in the top right corner; this is handwriting and is not transcribed.
